model_snapshot: public alias; immutable provider weight snapshot unavailable
condition_order: baseline first at even task positions; marginal first at odd positions
baseline: Codex without MARGINAL hooks or daemon
marginal: balanced policy plus default diminishing-return detector; experimental enforce; unlimited hard budgets
isolation: fresh official task container per lane; base-only git snapshot; no future history, reference patches, held-out tests, other lane output or host workspace mounted
quality_primary: official evaluator fail_to_pass AND pass_to_pass success
failure_policy: retain every attempt, timeout and invalid lane; no outcome-selected tasks or re-solving after grading; missing infrastructure is not silently excluded
quality_gate: no observed baseline-only regressions; descriptive, not proof of statistical equivalence
efficiency: provider input+output totals; cached input and reasoning output as subsets; paired tool calls, wall time, governance overhead and interventions
cost_usd: unavailable unless provider-reported; subscription usage is not an API invoice
analysis: all-task paired correctness and token totals; both-solved subset separately; task-bootstrap 95% interval for paired token reduction; do not infer equivalence from nonsignificance
stop_rules: stop new lanes on missing usage, failed hooks, isolation violation, insufficient disk or short quota >=80%; preserve resumable state; never label incomplete coverage complete
claim_limits: Experimental enforcement is not the installed plugin default Shadow Mode
One stochastic sample per task per condition
Self-published and independently regradable, not independent certification
A complete protocol is not a completed benchmark
